context: You come upon Lae'zel, an alien-looking githyanki trapped in a cage, while two tieflings debate her fate. The tieflings (Damays and Nymessa) disagree — Damays leans toward taking her back to camp to watch, while Nymessa urges you to shoot the cage down and kill her. In some branches the tieflings have already brought her down thinking they could bind her and bring her to the grove, and she resists violently; in others she may already be dead after a fight. If Shadowheart is present she will warn you not to trust Lae'zel based on past encounters with githyanki.
